name: PageIndex
description: 📑 PageIndex: Document Index for Vectorless, Reasoning-based RAG
one_liner: A smarter way for AI to search long documents like 1,000-page reports — instead of fuzzy keyword-style matching, it reads the document's structure like a human expert and can point to exactly where an answer came from.
buyer: A legal-tech or fintech startup building a document-Q&A product for law firms or financial analysts who need traceable, citable answers, not vague search results.
business_use_cases: A legal-tech startup builds a contract-review assistant that cites the exact clause and page it pulled an answer from, which lawyers can verify.
A financial analyst tool answers questions like 'what was the 2023 operating margin?' from a 10-K filing with a page-level citation for audit trails.
A regulatory compliance team indexes thousands of filings so staff can ask plain-English questions and get traceable answers instead of manually searching PDFs.

money_ideas.idea: Charge usage-based pricing on PageIndex Cloud for document indexing and chat queries.
Sell a vertical product (e.g. 'AI analyst for 10-Ks') built on top, priced per seat for finance/legal teams.

steal_this: This weekend, index a handful of public financial filings or legal documents with PageIndex's local mode, build a simple chat UI on top, and pitch it to a small law or accounting firm as a document-search demo.
